## Mechanism

Set once, then use it everywhere: `make sections MECH=r01`

Supported: `r01` · `r03` · `r21` · `dp2` · `r35`. Page limits and the section
list for each live in `_quarto-<mech>.yml` — **verify them against your NOFO**,
since NIH resets limits with each reissue.

## Section checklist

Limits below are the common defaults. Authoritative values are in the profile
yml for your mechanism; the build enforces them via `scripts/check_pages.py`.

| Section | Limit | Mechanisms | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 Project Summary / Abstract | 30 lines | all | ☐ |
| 02 Project Narrative | 3 sentences | all | ☐ |
| 03 Specific Aims | 1 pg | R01/R03/R21; forbidden for DP2/R35 | ☐ |
| 04 Standard Research Strategy | 12 pg R01 · 6 pg R03/R21 | R01/R03/R21 | ☐ |
| 04 DP2 Research Strategy + references | 10 pg | DP2 only | ☐ |
| 04 MIRA program-level Research Strategy | 6 pg | R35 only | ☐ |
| 05 Budget Justification | none | use MIRA-specific scaffold for R35 | ☐ |
| 06 Facilities & Other Resources | 1 pg DP2 · otherwise check NOFO | all | ☐ |
| 07 Equipment | none | all | ☐ |
| 08 Data Management & Sharing | 2 pg | all; select current or legacy format | ☐ |
| 10 Human Subjects | — | if applicable | ☐ |
| 11 Vertebrate Animals | — | if applicable | ☐ |
| 12 Authentication of Key Resources | 1 pg | if applicable | ☐ |
| 13 Mentoring Plan | per NOFO | K/F/T | ☐ |
| 14 Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan | none | multi-PI only | ☐ |
| 90 References Cited | none | all except DP2 (integrated into strategy) | ☐ |

## Not authored here

Prepared outside this repo and uploaded separately — track them anyway, since
they sink more submissions than the narrative sections do.

| Item | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Biosketches (5 pg each, all key personnel) | | ☐ |
| Letters of Support | | ☐ |
| **Letters of Reference (DP2: 3 required)** — submitted *by the referees*, separately from the application, by the reference deadline | | ☐ |
| Budget forms (SF424) | | ☐ |
| Cover Letter | | ☐ |
| Resource Sharing Plan(s) | | ☐ |

## Pre-submission checks

- [ ] `make sections MECH=<mech>` renders clean
- [ ] `make preflight MECH=<mech>` passes mechanism-specific structural checks
- [ ] Page limits pass (the build fails if not)
- [ ] No `TODO` / `TBD` / placeholder text left — including anything flagged
      `[like this]{color="alert"}` while drafting
- [ ] Figure captions readable at print size
- [ ] Citations resolve; bibliography has no stray hyperlinks
